subject: Encord x Zeiss | Workshop
text:
Hi Abouzar,

Hope you had a good festive period. As discussed at the end of last year,
i’m attaching some information below on Encord so you can share internally.

*TLDR*
Encord is the data development layer for medical and multimodal AI. We sit
between raw data and your models, turning images, video, and documents into
high quality training and evaluation datasets. Encord is a platform first,
meaning teams can use their own in house reviewers or combine the platform
with medically trained annotators provided by our team.
With groups like Zeiss, individuals can use Encord to run POC's/projects,
or use it across divisions on one shared platform, with secure workspaces,
permissions, and audibility so each team only sees what is relevant to
their project.

*Example use cases*

   - Surgical video and procedure data
      - Video native annotation, tool & phase tracking, QA across long
      surgical videos for training and validating models.
   - Document and VLM review
      - PDF Native and easy integration into VLM's or OCR models ran by
      Zeiss.
      - Human review, side by side comparison, scoring, and consensus to
      validate document generation and vision language model outputs for high
      risk data.
   - 2D medical imaging
      - Pixel accurate segmentation, classification, and landmarks for CT,
      MRI, X ray, and ultrasound with multi reviewer QA and audit trails.

*What differentiates Encord*
We provide the full data development layer in one system, covering
curation, annotation, quality control, and model evaluation so teams can
connect model performance directly back to the data that produced it.

We have recently been doing virtual workshops for groups at bigger
companies where we do a broad overview of the platform and services so that
individuals can raise a hand to learn more afterwards. Happy to do this
with your teams or do 121 intro's if that's easier?

Best,
